[NERR.3.1] **Status codes are grouped by number, by the concern that raises
them.** This table is the grouping, and the only statement of it. A code is its
number and its name; the group it falls in describes it.

| Range | Category |
|---|---|
| `0` | OK |
| `-1..-99` | Generic |
| `-100..-199` | Input |
| `-200..-299` | Runtime |
| `-300..-399` | Reserved: no code is produced or reused |
| `-400..-499` | Storage / callbacks |
| `-500..-549` | DSC container load |
| `-550..-599` | AOT code load |
| `-600..-625` | Native Rete, realtime and series-backend ABI |
| `-700..-704` | Dialect / artefact binding |
| `-710..-714` | Realtime contract |
| `-720..-730` | Event trace |
| `-10000` and below | Integrator-defined; an implementation never returns one |

Compiler diagnostics are not status codes ([RTCT.9.1]).
